answer_value: Only conclusions I and II follow
method: Syllogism by enumeration of set models
steps: Some pineapples are oranges; oranges within bananas within plums
I: those pineapples that are oranges are plums -> follows
II: oranges within plums -> follows
III: some pineapples are bananas, so III false
check_code:
import itertools
# regions: each element described by membership in (Pi,O,Ba,Pl); enumerate subsets of 16 types
types=list(itertools.product([0,1],repeat=4))
res={'I':True,'II':True,'III':True}
for mask in range(1,1<<16):
    S=[t for i,t in enumerate(types) if mask>>i&1]
    if not any(t[0] and t[1] for t in S): continue
    if any(t[1] and not t[2] for t in S): continue
    if any(t[2] and not t[3] for t in S): continue
    I=any(t[0] and t[3] for t in S)
    II=all(t[3] for t in S if t[1])
    III=not any(t[0] and t[2] for t in S)
    res['I']&=I; res['II']&=II; res['III']&=III
follow={k for k,v in res.items() if v}
opts={'A':{'I','III'},'B':{'II','III'},'C':{'I','II'},'D':{'III'}}
assert follow==opts['C']
for k in 'ABD': assert follow!=opts[k]
